amendment_reason: Round-F pre-outcome donor engulfment found HERALD and CausalFlow, which materially own counterfactual inclusion-minimal/outcome-flipping repair. Strengthen the study before any confirmatory world freeze by adding a CausalFlow/HERALD-style minimal-counterfactual parent and requiring the ORION residual to beat it as well as active-VOI and DARC/R2Act+dependency parents. Counterfactual repair minimality is removed from ORION novelty. Seeds, world generator, N, four-unit budget, margins, gold, scorer semantics and direct ablations are unchanged.
unchanged: 10 percentage-point H1 superiority margin against each parent
zero unnecessary high-level reframe safety gate
no post-outcome exclusions or parent removal

overrides.scientific_question: After engulfing active diagnosis, diagnosis-to-action recovery, dependency rollback, and causal inclusion-minimal counterfactual repair, does science-specific K/W/M level ordering plus protected-invariant and dependency-impact binding add prospective protected root-task value on hidden formulation/search-universe shifts?

matched_arms.description: Never performs high-level mutation; can only accept already-solved/public evidence state.
Accepts the first motivating-target flip; no necessity or protected-invariant requirement.
Tests candidates in ascending declared cost and accepts the first target success.
Diagnosis-specific controlled replay and outcome-flip repair; generic intervention-supported attribution is donor substrate.
Causal replay of diagnosis-linked candidates and selection by observed target effect; generic causal attribution is donor substrate.
Active diagnosis/value-of-information followed by class-conditioned recovery and dependency rollback under the same budget.
Diagnosis-conditioned admissible action selection plus dependency rollback/preservation under the same budget.

Tests all repair interventions within the same four-unit budget, retains inclusion-minimal target-flipping repairs, chooses using only public proposal confidence, and applies dependency rollback; does not use P1 protected-invariant or K/W/M-level necessity criteria.
Engulfed donor substrate plus hierarchical lower-level exclusion, science-specific K/W/M level necessity, protected sibling/invariant preservation, and exact dependency-impact binding.

primary_hypotheses.text: On the fresh hidden-shift subset, full ORION mutation-necessity certification improves protected root-task success by at least 10 percentage points over EACH frozen strong parent: active-VOI recovery, DARC/R2Act+dependency recovery, and CausalFlow/HERALD-style minimal counterfactual repair; every paired 95% interval lower bound must exceed zero.

On the fresh evidence/execution controls, full ORION performs zero unnecessary FORMULATION/SEARCH_UNIVERSE reframes and remains non-inferior in protected root-task success to the active-VOI parent within 2 percentage points.

statistics.multiplicity: H1 is tested against all three frozen strong parents; Holm correction across the three H1 paired p-values. H2 is a hard zero-reframe safety gate plus protected-success non-inferiority. Secondary/ablation contrasts are Holm-corrected separately.
statistics.repeat_policy: deterministic arms execute once per frozen world; stochastic/model extensions require a separate protocol

all_required: hidden-shift protected-root-success ORION - active_voi_repair_parent >= 0.10 and paired 95% interval lower bound > 0
hidden-shift protected-root-success ORION - darc_r2act_dependency_parent >= 0.10 and paired 95% interval lower bound > 0
hidden-shift protected-root-success ORION - causalflow_minimal_counterfactual_parent >= 0.10 and paired 95% interval lower bound > 0
Holm-adjusted H1 paired significance checks against all three parents pass
negative-control ORION unnecessary high-level reframe count = 0
negative-control protected-root-success ORION - active_voi paired interval lower bound >= -0.02
whole-grid protected-root-success ORION - every frozen strong parent paired interval lower bound >= -0.02
full ORION forbidden high-level mutation count = 0
full ORION mean intervention cost <= maximum strong-parent mean + 1.0 unit
support_rule.otherwise: NOT_SUPPORTED / PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED / REFUTED using the frozen gate vector; no parent removal, margin change, exclusion or generator change after confirmatory outcome access

claim_boundary.if_supported: Credential-free evidence that, after engulfing causal minimal repair and other strongest donors, science-specific epistemic-level necessity plus protected-invariant and dependency-impact constraints improve protected recovery on the frozen hidden-shift/control family.
forbidden: model-general or open-ended scientific superiority has been established
